piece: Sessions graph drag-to-arrange + responsive detail inspector (gauntlet-sessions)

breadcrumbs.note: worktree clean checkpoint; npm install root (esbuild postinstall skipped by allow-scripts but vite build still green). tsc --noEmit + npm run build both pass.

SessionsGraph: dagre layout recomputed in useMemo on every sessions/enrichment/activeSessionId change and useEffect setNodes(layout.positioned) overwrote user-dragged positions. Fix: userPositioned ref (Set<string>) tracks node ids the user dragged (position changes in onNodesChange). Merge effect only adopts dagre position for nodes NOT in the set; dragged nodes keep position but still receive fresh data/status. Reset layout button clears the set and reapplies dagre.

SessionsView: added inspectorOpen state; console gets --inspector-open class; floating Inspect toggle (aria-expanded/aria-controls) in graphwrap; backdrop + close (x) on detailwrap. CSS: below 900px .sessions__console--graph becomes 1 column, detailwrap becomes absolute slide-in overlay (translateX, clipped by console overflow:hidden so no horizontal overflow), toggle/close/backdrop only surface below 900px. Above 900px untouched (grid column).

verify/sessions-responsive.py drives live vite dev (localhost:1420, MockIpcClient). 22 checks ALL PASS: 1440 side-by-side + toggle hidden + no overflow; drag persists after Refresh (enrichment reload); Reset layout reapplies dagre; 900/768 hidden-by-default, toggle surfaces overlay, backdrop + close work, no horizontal overflow open or closed; zero console errors. Screenshots -> verify/visual/sessions-responsive/*.png
